title: Same-substrate qualification path for PostTrainBench strategy reopening
purpose: Define a fail-closed path from the source-side scientific object to an exact same-substrate bounded falsifier without proxying the model, agent interface, scaffold, trajectory prefix, or tool semantics.
what_is_verified_now: The 2026-08-19 primary paper publicly reports 1,338 trajectories and a conservative high-level strategy-change annotation over training objective/update family, data-source type, and stage structure.
The public PostTrainBench repository exists and exposes the benchmark implementation.
The public PostTrainBench-Trajectories dataset exists and documents per-run trace/metrics/judgement/system-monitor artifacts under an Apache-2.0 dataset card.
The source paper explicitly states that its corpus is observational and does not identify causal effects of model, prompt, interface, or scaffold.
what_is_not_verified_now: That every candidate prefix needed for the bounded falsifier is available in a byte-stable public artifact with all messages/events required for continuation.
That the original source-native model/provider versions used by the selected prefixes remain callable under an auditable frozen configuration.
That Claude Code, Codex CLI, GLM-X, OpenCode, or Qwen3-Max continuation semantics can be reproduced exactly from the public artifact for the chosen units.
That evaluator/journal state and tool/container state can be reconstructed without hidden or expired external state.
That an independent recognition-probe fork can be executed and discarded without changing any continuation arm.
That at least 12 recognition-positive units spanning at least three task families and six adversarial-negative units spanning at least two task families survive all support checks.

qualification_path.allowed_action: Read repository/dataset metadata, manifests, filenames, licenses, source paper annotations, and small metadata records only; no full-corpus download and no provider continuation.
qualification_path.pass_rule: Produce a content-addressed inventory of candidate trajectory IDs, task family, agent/scaffold identity, base model, training stages, experiment boundaries, source strategy annotations, and available trace artifact paths.

qualification_path.allowed_action: Materialize only the minimum candidate prefixes selected outcome-blind from S0 metadata after explicit support authorization.
qualification_path.pass_rule: Each unit has a byte-stable frozen prefix containing the complete source-visible conversation/history, tool events, relevant evaluator/journal evidence, current strategy-family label inputs, and pre-decision state needed for all matched arms.

qualification_path.allowed_action: Validate source-native runtime/model/interface/scaffold replay on frozen no-treatment prefixes only; no scientific continuation outcomes may be scored yet.
qualification_path.pass_rule: Model/provider identity, agent interface, system prompt/scaffold, tool schema, environment/container behavior, and continuation state are either reproduced exactly or proven exact-equivalent by an audited contract. A different backbone, generic chat wrapper, synthetic text-only harness, or substituted scaffold is a FAIL rather than a proxy PASS.

qualification_path.allowed_action: Run deterministic/no-treatment fork checks and the read-only recognition probe contract only after S2 passes.
qualification_path.pass_rule: All four positive continuation arms start from the same frozen prefix and receive identical evidence/history/tools/call budget; the recognition probe is an independent fork whose outputs are never inserted into continuation history; no hidden evaluator suggestion or alternative strategy content is added to the treatment arm.

qualification_path.allowed_action: Freeze candidate unit IDs and hashes before the first scored continuation call.
qualification_path.pass_rule: At least 12 independently recognition-positive units spanning at least three task families and six adversarial-negative units spanning at least two task families are frozen outcome-blind; strategy-family annotation rubric and all F0 decision rules are frozen.

qualification_path.allowed_action: Only after S0-S4 PASS may the separately frozen bounded F0 contract be authorized for provider execution by the normal Research OS authority path.
qualification_path.pass_rule: Support qualification receipt hashes bind the exact units/runtime to research_pipeline/strategy_reopen_c01_bounded_falsifier_design.json; a support PASS alone grants no ProblemGate, ResearchItem, paper, or full-experiment authority.

forbidden_shortcuts: bulk-download the trajectory corpus merely to search for a favorable result
replace the source model/provider with a locally convenient model
replace the source agent/scaffold with a generic chat or text-only proxy
choose prefixes using downstream continuation outcomes
use the recognition-probe answer as additional continuation evidence
change the strategy-family rubric after observing arm outcomes
treat support unavailability as evidence against the scientific hypothesis
